context: Treat historical failures as evidence, not as a permanent veto. Verify that the latest workflow_dispatch is successful, that its head contains the PR #1349 merge, and that both SSB DataFusion matrix jobs succeeded. Then drop the malformed v2 and original active proof items as superseded and complete this replacement without code changes.
description: The original Seed Corpus proof item is held open by an immutable historical assertion that can never recover after run 30455422794 failed. Run 30574449328 later completed successfully after PR #1349 merged. Replace the point-in-time window with a latest-dispatch criterion, inspect the selected DataFusion and bundle-location jobs, and preserve both the failed and successful run links.

anti_patterns.dont: Require that no historical failure exists after a fixed timestamp
anti_patterns.instead: Evaluate the latest relevant post-fix dispatch and its selected jobs
anti_patterns.why: A repaired workflow can never satisfy that monotonic historical assertion

preserves.behavior: Run 30455422794 remains recorded as the failure that exposed both root causes
Run 30574449328 remains the post-fix success proof
The workflow stays dispatch-only; no schedule is added without separate authorization

verifications.command: gh run list --repo joeharris76/BenchBox --workflow seed-corpus.yml --event workflow_dispatch --limit 1 --json conclusion --jq '.[0].conclusion' | grep -qx success
verifications.description: Latest Seed Corpus dispatch is successful
verifications.expected: passes now and fails when the latest relevant dispatch is unsuccessful

verifications.command: test "$(gh run view 30574449328 --repo joeharris76/BenchBox --json jobs --jq '[.jobs[]|select((.name=="ssb / datafusion / sf0.01" or .name=="ssb / datafusion / sf0.1") and .conclusion=="success")]|length')" -eq 2
verifications.description: Successful dispatch contains both SSB DataFusion cells
verifications.expected: passes for the repaired run and fails if either formerly broken DataFusion cell is absent or unsuccessful

work_units.summary: Revalidate the latest Seed Corpus dispatch and PR #1349 ancestry
Inspect SSB DataFusion and bundle-location job conclusions
Preserve failed and successful run evidence and reconcile superseded items
